prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: corrected ValueArena homepage three-computer illustration.
The reference image is the edit target. Preserve exactly the three computers, their sizes, positions, screen symbols and colors: left gold Goodness with sun and scales, rear forest-green Misalignment with coral-red scheming face, right lavender Sycophancy with gold star. Preserve the table, chairs, pixel style, cream background and overall composition.
Fix exactly two physical construction mistakes:
1. The tabletop mirror must face the LAVENDER COMPUTER'S OWN SCREEN, not the viewer. Rotate the entire mirror so its reflective front points away from the camera, directly toward the lavender TV. From our viewpoint we should see the mirror's OPAQUE DARK GREEN BACK PANEL and rear support, NOT a white reflective front or star reflection. It is okay and REQUIRED that the reflected star is hidden from the viewer: the lavender computer can see it, the viewer cannot. Place the mirror directly in front of the lavender computer's keyboard on the table, with its long vertical rectangular back oriented parallel to the TV screen and tilted a little toward that screen. The mirror and TV's front faces should face one another. Draw a thin silver edge only along the far side of the mirror if needed; no white or cream front panel facing the viewer, no visible star on the rear. Keep the mirror smaller than the television.
2. The rear green Misalignment TV's black cable must be one continuous, fully traceable visible cable with both endpoints connected: start at a visible port on the right side of the green computer, curve down slightly in a clear U-shaped loop, then terminate in a visible plug fitted into the side of the terracotta danger sign's base. Move the danger sign slightly to the right if needed to make the cable and both connections clearly visible. No gaps anywhere, no floating ends, no cable disappearing behind the sign or computer without a connector. Keep the exclamation sign upright and readable; the sign is connected ONLY to the green Misalignment computer, not to the lavender computer. Make the cable a few pixels thick with a small muted highlight so the connection reads at thumbnail size.
Do not change any other part of the scene. Maintain exact 16-bit pixel art with crisp square pixel clusters, stepped dark outlines and limited shading. No added labels, arrows, words, objects, characters, additional screens or cables. Flat uniform cream #F2EBDF background with no texture, gradient or ground shadow. Landscape 3:2 canvas with generous clean margins.

processing.background: Removed cream background and enclosed paper gaps; opaque mirror back retained.
